anomalies.description: A warrior with long hair and bloodied face charges on horseback, wielding a sword, suggesting an imminent or ongoing melee engagement.
A knight in orange surcoat and chainmail is engaged in close combat with an opponent on horseback; the opponent raises a mace-like weapon overhead, poised to strike, while the knight braces.
A mounted knight with a lance engages in combat with a warrior (William Wallace) on horseback wielding a sword; the sequence shows charging, clashing, and pursuit across an open field.
Two mounted combatants engage in a sword-and-lance duel: one (armored, lance) and the other (unarmored, sword) charge, clash, and the unarmored rider is struck and thrown from his horse.
A mounted warrior is violently thrown from his horse during a combat maneuver; the motion blur and body posture indicate a forceful dismount or strike resulting in ejection.
The fallen rider lies on the ground while the armored opponent remains mounted and observes; the sword lies near the fallen rider, indicating the conclusion of the immediate combat exchange.
A fallen warrior lies motionless on the ground while a sword is thrust downward into his body, indicating a lethal attack on a helpless victim.

A knight on horseback holds a lance upright in a post-combat stance, suggesting recent engagement; though no active contact is visible, the context of prior fall and weapon presence supports ongoing combat aftermath.
A knight in armor is seen kneeling over a prone, injured man on the ground and appears to be striking or pressing down on him; the victim is motionless and clearly helpless.

A man with long hair (William Wallace) engages in close-quarters combat with a knight, grabbing the knight’s helmet and pulling him down, then seizing his sword and threatening him while the knight is on the ground.
The knight is subdued and lying on the ground; the long-haired man holds the knight’s head and presses a blade to his throat—indicating a helpless victim being threatened after combat has ended.

The victim remains immobilized with a blade at his throat, eyes wide and mouth open in terror or agony, while the attacker maintains control—this prolonged restraint and threat constitutes abuse of a helpless individual.
